I just met Jason and Keri on my walk across the state. They lost their food stamps bc of Trump’s cuts. 

They are taking a bus back and forth to New Haven today for a meal from a soup kitchen there. 

A 6 hour commute for a meal. 

And Elon Musk just became a trillionaire.

posts.text:
Great to end my 10th walk across Connecticut with friends in Bridgeport. 

This year’s walk:

4 days. 70 miles.

Colebrook
Winsted
Torrington 
Harwinton
Thomaston 
Plymouth
Waterbury 
Naugatuck 
Beacon Falls
Seymour
Ansonia
Derby
Shelton
Trumbull
Bridgeport https://t.co/ncM7cpB4d6
And, tell us about your footwear! https://t.co/xxopq8UXgz

In which I answer a couple questions people have about the walk across Connecticut, while I’m walking…

Like, do you walk the same route each year? https://t.co/IHpIY4CRA2

Stopped in to see the crew at “the original” Vazzy’s - a Bridgeport institution! 

Come by. It’s a great meal and a friendly staff! https://t.co/DsfCy8YH6c

Stopped by the Nichols Fire Department in Trumbull to talk about the ways volunteer departments (like Trumbull) help build community and connection. 

Now I’m leaving Trumbull (good signage!) and will finish up my walk in an hour or so in Bridgeport! https://t.co/siKUMFvgbX

Thanks for the friendly team at Wells Hollow Farm for showing me around during the last day of my walk across the state. They sell tons of locally produced fruit and vegetables. And an ice cream shop next door!

Check it out! https://t.co/APjt6qjnBt

During the slow parts of the walk - early morning or in rural areas - I listen to music. My music taste is all over the map (and the subject of much ridicule from friends, staff, and my kids). 

Here’s what I’ve been listening to on this year’s walk. https://t.co/9ZhczSoX96

Walking through Shelton, I stopped by Wiffle Ball - an iconic Connecticut company. 

Listen to this cool story about how this family run company - that still makes each Wiffle Ball in Shelton - started. https://t.co/22HsDDNQ0f
Starting the final day of my annual Walk Across Connecticut in Shelton! https://t.co/wDLqZfKSm3
Uh there is a place in Derby where you smash and break stuff for fun. These are things you learn when you walk from one end of the state to the other. https://t.co/zsBEwqOj9X

Walked through Ansonia today with the Mayor and Sen. Cabrera. Lots of new restaurants, including GR8 Coffee.

Also ran into my friends at the Valley Proud Center- in the middle of conducting a job interview! They included her in the pic so I think they have to give her the job. https://t.co/oXqsOhqD1O

Thanks to the great team at Agave Diner in Seymour for having me in for lunch. The churro french toast was out of this world! 

This is why every year when I walk 80-100 miles across the state I GAIN weight. https://t.co/mcsA3LUZC7
Into the woods. #WalkAcrossCT https://t.co/pbwphajUQA
Day 3 of my annual Walk Across Connecticut starts in Waterbury. 20 more miles today. Threatening skies but no major rain yet. https://t.co/jyV4vCUFR0
